description: Use for "price a same-game NFL combo" and "is this combo worth it". Pass nflGame ("NYG-LAR", "Giants vs Rams") to list that game's Kalshi legs — moneyline, spreads, totals, player props — then legIds to price your pick with the correlation done for you. Or pass legPrices + trueWinProbability for a fair band; add offeredOdds for EV and a verdict. Free.

kind.description: With nflGame: "game" = all game lines, "prop" = props only. One of: game · prop.

legIds.description: 2–6 leg ids from a previous nflGame call (an array, or one comma-separated string). We compute the correlation-aware joint for exactly these legs.

legPrices.description: Each leg's YES price in cents (1–99). Used only for the theoretical assemble ceiling. Omit when using nflGame + legIds — we read the real prices.

limit.description: With nflGame: max props listed (default 40, max 200).

nflGame.description: An NFL game on the live board, as "AWAY-HOME" (e.g. "NYG-LAR"). Alone: lists its legs with ids, trimmed (narrow with player/stat/kind/limit). With legIds: prices that exact combo.

offeredAmerican.description: Alias for offeredOdds (the response reports the quote as offered_american, so this name is accepted on input too). American odds or a decimal multiplier, same parsing. If both are given, offeredOdds wins.

offeredOdds.description: The combo price your platform actually quotes — American odds (e.g. -150, 988) or a decimal payout multiplier (e.g. 10.7). Grades EV + verdict against fair value. Omit to get fair value + band only.

player.description: With nflGame: every strike for a player whose name contains this (e.g. "Mariota").

stat.description: With nflGame: props of one stat (e.g. "rec_yds").

trueWinProbability.description: Your correlation-aware estimate of the true joint probability all legs hit, in % (0–100). Omit when using nflGame + legIds — we compute it from the scoreline model.

name: combo_edge
title: Combo Edge Verdict
